signature.name: VTask.of
signature.type: {R : Type u_1} -> {ι : Type u_2} -> [Preorder ι] -> (G : ι → Type u_3) -> {T : ⦃i j : ι⦄ → i ≤ j → Type u_6} -> (f : (x x_1 : ι) → (h : x ≤ x_1) → T h) -> [(i j : ι) → (h : i ≤ j) → FunLike (T h) (G i) (G j)] -> [DirectedSystem G fun x1 x2 x3 => ⇑(f x1 x2 x3)] -> [IsDirectedOrder ι] -> [CommSemiring R] -> [(i : ι) → NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring (G i)] -> [(i : ι) → DistribMulAction R (G i)] -> [∀ (i j : ι) (h : i ≤ j), NonUnitalAlgHomClass (T h) R (G i) (G j)] -> [Nonempty ι] -> (i : ι) -> G i →ₙₐ[R] DirectLimit G f

conventions.note: NONE_DECLARED: VTask.of is a total construction with no junk-value conventions; it produces a valid non-unital algebra homomorphism for every index i and every valid directed system.

facts.statement: ∀ {R : Type*} {ι : Type*} [Preorder ι] (G : ι → Type*) {T : ⦃i j : ι⦄ → i ≤ j → Type*} (f : ∀ x x_1 : ι, ∀ h : x ≤ x_1, T h) [∀ i j : ι, ∀ h : i ≤ j, FunLike (T h) (G i) (G j)] [DirectedSystem G (fun x1 x2 x3 => ⇑(f x1 x2 x3))] [IsDirectedOrder ι] [CommSemiring R] [∀ i : ι, NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring (G i)] [∀ i : ι, DistribMulAction R (G i)] [∀ i j : ι, ∀ h : i ≤ j, NonUnitalAlgHomClass (T h) R (G i) (G j)] [Nonempty ι] (i : ι) (x y : G i), x = y → VTask.of G f i x = VTask.of G f i y
